onset.Description: Intended onset of the scene (study trials) or scene cue (test trials), relative to the start of the run.

duration.Description: Intended on-screen duration of the scene/cue (duplicate of stim_dur).

trial_type.Description: Type of learning-task trial (duplicate of run_type).

Levels.study: Scene-location association study trial: scene followed by its associated location
Levels.test: Memory-guided saccade test trial: scene cue followed by a blank response period

stim_file.Description: Path to the displayed scene image, relative to /stimuli/.

cat_group.Description: Counterbalancing group label indicating which half of the scene-location associations this trial's scene belongs to (used to structure study/test block order; see Methods).

fback_dur.Description: Intended duration of the correct-location feedback shown after a response, on test trials (n/a on study trials).

isi.Description: Inter-stimulus interval between the scene cue and the response period (test trials; n/a on study trials).

loc_dur.Description: Duration the associated location was displayed, on study trials (n/a on test trials).

next_comp_ang.Description: Polar angle (degrees) of the competitor location associated with this trial's scene (i.e., the target location of this scene's pairmate). Column name retains the 'next_' prefix used in the shared data-logging code across tasks, but here it refers to this scene's own competitor location, not an upcoming trial (unlike in task-search).

next_comp_x.Description: Cartesian x-coordinate (degrees of visual angle) corresponding to next_comp_ang.

next_comp_y.Description: Cartesian y-coordinate (degrees of visual angle) corresponding to next_comp_ang.

next_targ_comp_dist.Description: Angular distance (degrees) between this scene's target and competitor locations.

next_target_ang.Description: Polar angle (degrees) of the target location associated with this trial's scene (the location being studied/tested). Column name retains the 'next_' prefix used in the shared data-logging code across tasks, but here it refers to this scene's own target location, not an upcoming trial (unlike in task-search).

next_target_x.Description: Cartesian x-coordinate (degrees of visual angle) corresponding to next_target_ang.

next_target_y.Description: Cartesian y-coordinate (degrees of visual angle) corresponding to next_target_ang.

resp_dur.Description: Duration of the response window, on test trials (n/a on study trials).

run.Description: Run number, as recorded in the source data file.

run_type.Description: Type of learning-task trial (duplicate of trial_type).

stim_dur.Description: Intended scene/cue presentation duration (duplicate of duration).

stim_exemplar.Description: Exemplar number (1 or 2) distinguishing pairmates within a scene category.

stim_name.Description: Base stimulus identifier for the presented scene.

target_eccen.Description: Eccentricity (degrees of visual angle) of the studied target/competitor locations; fixed at 3.3.

stim_onset.Description: Measured (actual, not intended) onset of scene/cue presentation. Recorded for QA purposes to confirm presentation timing.

loc_onset.Description: Measured (actual) onset of the location display (study trials) or feedback location (test trials). Recorded for QA purposes only.

loc_offset.Description: Measured (actual) offset of the location display / feedback location. Recorded for QA purposes only.

resp_x.Description: Horizontal gaze position (degrees of visual angle) of the memory-guided saccade response (test trials only). Used for participant feedback not analyses.

resp_y.Description: Vertical gaze position (degrees of visual angle) of the memory-guided saccade response (test trials only). Used for participant feedback not analyses.

rt.Description: Saccadic reaction time, when defined (test trials only).

targ_err.Description: Angular error (degrees) between the saccade endpoint and the target location (test trials only). Used for participant feedback not analyses.

comp_err.Description: Angular error (degrees) between the saccade endpoint and the competitor location (test trials only). Used for participant feedback not analyses.

acc.Description: Whether the saccade endpoint fell within the target location (boolean; test trials only). Used for participant feedback not analyses.

acc_closer.Description: Whether the saccade endpoint fell closer to the target location than to the competitor location (boolean; test trials only). Used for participant feedback not analyses.
